$comment: Every value this package exports, claimed once: as a block (plain name + what it is for), as part of one ("with"), or as internal. Read by scripts/catalogue.mjs; pnpm check:catalogue fails when this file and the package disagree.

blocks.name: Button
blocks.for: The standard button (primary, secondary, ghost, busy), and rows or grids of them sharing the width.

blocks.name: Icon button
blocks.for: A square icon-only button, and the quiet borderless one for a close X or a clear-field cross.

blocks.name: Switch
blocks.for: A labelled on/off switch; tapping its text flips it. compact: a smaller label close to its switch, for the stage or under a preview.

blocks.name: Slider
blocks.for: A labelled slider with a typed value box, clamping, units and a help tip.

blocks.name: Stepper
blocks.for: A label with a minus/plus pair round an editable number.

blocks.name: Option tabs
blocks.for: Pick one of a few options: text tabs, icon cards or picture tiles (a segmented control, a radio group to screen readers); fit content and a compact size for a bar over a preview.

blocks.name: Dropdown
blocks.for: A labelled dropdown, with its options swappable after it is built.

blocks.name: Form fields
blocks.for: Labelled text, number (with unit), multi-line and live-search fields, and a checkbox.

blocks.name: Chip
blocks.for: A small filter or tag toggle; centered for a chip stretched to fill a grid cell.

blocks.name: Help tip
blocks.for: A "?" badge that shows a one-line explanation on hover or focus.

blocks.name: Colour well
blocks.for: A bare colour well for picking any colour.

blocks.name: Colour picker
blocks.for: The floating colour picker a swatch opens.

blocks.name: D-pad
blocks.for: Four arrows plus centre, for moving or rotating something in steps.

blocks.name: Nudge pad
blocks.for: Fine position nudges in X and Y, with the offset shown.

blocks.name: Panel section
blocks.for: A heading with rows under it, open or collapsible, and a quiet "Show more" fold under one control.

blocks.name: Dialog
blocks.for: An accessible modal window (focus held, Escape closes the top one), a one-line prompt, and holdModal for an overlay built elsewhere.

blocks.name: Two-pane window
blocks.for: A large dialog with a preview on one side and settings on the other; the frame the import wizards use.

blocks.name: Toast
blocks.for: A small message that appears for a moment and goes away.

blocks.name: Drawer
blocks.for: A panel that slides in from the edge (the phone settings sheet, the changelog).

blocks.name: Menu
blocks.for: A dropdown menu anchored to a button.

blocks.name: Popover
blocks.for: Content hanging off a control, closed by clicking away.

blocks.name: Loading and empty states
blocks.for: A progress bar, a loading placeholder, the busy chip on the stage, and the "nothing here yet" panel.

blocks.name: List row
blocks.for: A full-width row: thumbnail, label and trailing detail.

blocks.name: Gallery cards
blocks.for: Picture cards in a responsive grid, for choosing a template or a design.

blocks.name: Side navigation
blocks.for: A vertical list of pages or groups to switch between.

blocks.name: Source cards
blocks.for: The Image / SVG / Text cards at the top of an input panel; layout tiles for a longer list (icon over a two-line name).

blocks.name: File drop zone
blocks.for: Click or drag a file in, and the slim "replace this file" row once one is loaded.

blocks.name: Sample tiles
blocks.for: Square picture tiles to start from a sample, in a grid.

blocks.name: SVG wizard
blocks.for: The SVG import window: shows the file and what the tracer made of it, and lets the user choose parts, colours and outline or fill.

blocks.name: Font chooser
blocks.for: THE font block: recommended font cards, "Browse all" library, style chips, import a font, and warnings when a font cannot write the text. fontCards and fontPicker are its parts.

blocks.name: Symbol chooser
blocks.for: THE symbol picker: every symbol set on the shelf (Material, Tabler, Fluent) in one window with categories and search, handing back the symbol as shapes ready to cut or extrude.

blocks.name: Symbol picker (Material only)
blocks.for: The older drawer of Material Symbols glyphs, or of any items with a path each (the clicker's base shapes). For symbols, use the Symbol chooser.

blocks.name: Symbol library
blocks.for: The large symbol window the Symbol chooser opens: categories, search, async tiles, an import button. Give it your own list only for something that is not a symbol of the shelf.

blocks.name: Symbol text field
blocks.for: A text field that holds symbols as inline tokens beside the letters, plus the rules for where a symbol may sit.

blocks.name: Symbol inspector
blocks.for: One placed symbol's own controls, folded under its name.

blocks.name: Undo/redo buttons
blocks.for: The undo, refresh and redo buttons. The history itself is still each app's own.

blocks.name: Stage overlays
blocks.for: Controls floating on the 3D or 2D stage: the click-mode pill, the bottom panel (its title can be hidden), the view switches, and a grip on the model with its value.

blocks.name: Status line
blocks.for: The one-line status at the bottom left of the stage (or the top left): what the generator is doing, or what is wrong. Announced to screen readers. setDiagnostics shows the worst problem and how many there are.

blocks.name: Diagnostics
blocks.for: Warnings and errors about the model as built (invariant #13): every one listed with what to do, the worst on the status line, and export refused while an error stands, in its own words.

blocks.name: Key grid
blocks.for: A small map of a grid of keys laid out exactly as they will sit, each showing its legend; tapping a cell adds or removes a key, which is how a custom block layout is drawn.

blocks.name: Changelog
blocks.for: The update timeline, opened from its button into a drawer.

blocks.name: What's new card
blocks.for: A card listing what changed, shown once per version.

blocks.name: Export panel
blocks.for: Format buttons with a busy state and a note. No app uses it yet: the generators export from the Sidebar footer.

blocks.name: Offline download button
blocks.for: "Download the offline version": the single-file copy of the app.

blocks.name: Element builder
blocks.for: Create an element (el) or an SVG element (svgNode) with its class, attributes and children in one call: the way every block is built, never a string of markup.

blocks.name: App frame
blocks.for: The standard generator layout: settings on the left, the stage in the middle, the product panel on the right, with the phone layout built in. A compact panel for one that is a settings rail.

blocks.name: Generator header
blocks.for: Title, one-line description and "Made by Vostok Labs" at the top of a panel (compact, at the top of a page); the print-quality callout and the credit strip at its foot.

blocks.name: Sidebar footer
blocks.for: The sticky foot of the product panel: the export button(s), then Save, Load, Help and light/dark.

blocks.name: Top bar
blocks.for: The standard top bar: GitHub and the commercial licence on the left, MakerWorld and Ko-fi on the right. Links come from @vostok/brand.

blocks.name: Settings rail
blocks.for: A vertical icon rail where each icon opens one group of settings; flush to fill a panel that is the rail and nothing else.

blocks.name: Editor frame
blocks.for: The design-studio layout: top bar, tool rail, canvas, floating object panel and status strip.

blocks.name: Build loop
blocks.for: One rebuild at a time, always from the newest settings; export waits on settled() so it never ships an older preview, and with diagnose it refuses a build that carries an error.

blocks.name: Worker requests
blocks.for: Talk to a geometry worker by request id: every request gets exactly its own reply, and a crashed worker fails its callers instead of hanging.

blocks.name: Settings sync
blocks.for: After a load, undo, share link or reset: push the settings into the controls and take back what each control can show, so out-of-range values are clamped.

blocks.name: Licence pop-up
blocks.for: Invariant #3 in one call at the end of every export: the full licence window on the first download, the corner reminder after.

blocks.name: Lifetime licence windows
blocks.for: The lifetime-licence offer, and the owner's certificate with the full licence text.

blocks.name: Project file
blocks.note: Save markProject(shape, project) with downloadFile() from @vostok/export, and read with the same shape (the app's id and the keys every file of it has). Hand it the app's apply (coerce, then the settings sync): a file the app cannot use gets the same message, and the cause goes to the console.
blocks.for: Read back a saved project the person picked (UTF-8 or UTF-16): the parsed settings, or a clear message when the file is not a project or another app saved it.

blocks.name: State store
blocks.for: One object of app state, patched with set() and watched with subscribe(); no DOM, so a node test can drive it.

blocks.name: Share link
blocks.for: Put the current settings into the page link and copy it; read them back on load.

blocks.name: Light/dark theme
blocks.for: One light/dark choice shared by every app, and the button that toggles it.

blocks.name: Animation on/off
blocks.for: The reduced-motion preference shared by every app, and its button.

blocks.name: Cover image capture
blocks.for: Render one fresh frame of the stage and capture it as a picture, for listing covers.

blocks.name: Design tokens from code
blocks.for: Read a colour token off the page for three.js or a 2D canvas, so a scene matches the chrome. Never copy a hex.

blocks.name: Host environment
blocks.for: Run the same app on the website, inside the desktop host or embedded: file picking, remembered imports and outbound links go through the host when there is one.

blocks.name: Filament colours
blocks.for: Rows of common PLA/PETG colours plus a custom colour, one row per part, and a contrast check between two colours.

blocks.name: Interface icons
blocks.licence: ISC and MIT: stroke icons drawn from Lucide (ISC) and Feather (MIT), the GitHub mark from Octicons (MIT); licence texts beside icons.ts
blocks.for: The small icons on buttons and menus, inline SVG. Interface only: never part of a customer's export.

blocks.name: Symbol set: Tabler + Fluent
blocks.licence: MIT (Tabler Icons filled; Microsoft Fluent Emoji High Contrast); licence texts beside the data
blocks.for: The 75 symbols the clicker's library traces from SVG. The same drawings, and more, are in the symbol library (@vostok/symbols); this goes when the clicker moves onto it.

internal.why: Version stamp read by the kit itself.
